cost_band_rule.L1: operations, field audit, furniture and wayfinding; obtain quotations before commitment
cost_band_rule.L2: temporary structure, ground-floor adaptation or local system; enter only after G1-G2
cost_band_rule.L3: permanent capital works; excluded until official controls, ownership and statutory procedures are complete

projects.scope_in: six conditional segments, east-west stitch gaps, ordinary walking and cycling baseline

projects.evidence: signed field-audit sheets plus versioned gap atlas
projects.dependency: official street, rail, crossing, ownership and heritage information
projects.stop_restore: stop spatial claims when provenance is absent; retain the existing ordinary route
projects.stop_restore_zh: 来源不明即停止空间主张；保留现有普通路线

projects.scope_in: public garden, explanation porch, controlled test loop, logistics separation and physical stop
projects.scope_out: river engineering, permanent laboratory buildings, unattended public testing

projects.title_en: AI Origin Rights and Contribution Arcade

projects.minimum_resource_en: 1 output window + 1 rights desk + 1 co-test table + 1 everyday lane

projects.days_0_30_zh: 清权一项成果的来源、许可、人工联系人和撤回路径
projects.days_31_60: fit one reversible window-desk-table sequence without closing the ordinary lane

projects.days_61_90_zh: 仅在自身PASS闭合后允许一个可逆场景入场
projects.acceptance_kpi: zero mandatory digital gate; human handover target <=30 s; appeal receipt available
projects.acceptance_kpi_zh: 零强制数字门槛；人工接管目标≤30秒；提供申诉回执
projects.evidence: field-verification sheet, timed handover drill, paper receipt, access audit, equipment inventory and restored ordinary-service record

projects.stop_restore: failed handover, unavailable appeal or blocked passage removes the plug-in and restores staffed ordinary service

projects.title_zh: 十二场景公共验收协议
projects.scope_in: twelve passports, four non-compensable gates, red lines and offline tabletop paths

projects.dependency: named operators and applicable legal/professional review
projects.stop_restore: any missing gate or red-line failure keeps AI off and invokes that place's no-AI baseline

projects.scope_in: reversible mileage, source and contribution markers along a six-part conditional narrative

projects.days_61_90: publish corrected narrative and contribution record

projects.acceptance_kpi: 100% displayed historical statements have a public citation and human editor
projects.acceptance_kpi_zh: 100%展示的历史表述具有公开引文和人工编辑者
projects.evidence: source ledger, rights review and correction history
projects.dependency: official heritage inventory and professional interpretation review
projects.stop_restore: disputed or unverified material is removed; ordinary wayfinding remains

projects.scope_out: festival-only spectacle, unverified rankings, institutional commitments not yet agreed
